claims.statement: Production server is x86_64/amd64 only; building arm64 images breaks Redis container compatibility and provider SDK signing paths, and any PR that introduces arm64 conditions is rejected at code review.
make deploy SSHes to the production host, pulls the latest image tags, runs pending migrations, recreates the backend and frontend containers, and runs a smoke check against /api/v1/health.
Migration discipline is forward-only with idempotent recovery scripts; the api-server is restarted only after the schema is current, and downgrades are not assumed safe without testing.
Redis is rebuildable from the source of truth (MySQL): it holds cache + queues + streams + rate-limit counters and the system recovers on first use after a Redis loss.

Wallet state (wallet_payments, wallet_topups, wallet_ipn, ledger) is part of the backup contract; restoring from a stale backup can produce a replay loop with the provider and the IPN handler must deduplicate via wallet_ipn.invoice_no.

Runtime feature gates (PASSWORD_RESET_ENABLE, DISBURSEMENT_FEE_FAIL_OPEN, ENABLE_NINEPAY) flip behavior without redeploy; .env carries ONPAY_*, NINEPAY_*, ZALO_* (seed only), JWT signing keys, and DB credentials and is gitignored.
